ATI has demonstrated solid fundamental progress, with expanding gross margins reaching 23% and free cash flow per share rising to $3.87. However, the market cap has quadrupled in less than two years, pushing the P/E ratio up to an exorbitant 65.39. Paying 65 times earnings for a capital-intensive metal fabrication business leaves zero margin of safety and demands absolute perfection.

Paying over 65 times earnings for a metal fabrication business with modest 10% net margins is pure speculative madness. While earnings per share grew modestly from $2.52 in 2022 to $3.49, the market capitalization expanded more than sixfold to $31 billion. I will not pay a silly price for a capital-intensive industrial company carrying a debt-to-equity ratio above 1.1.
